title: Reddit stock tumbles the most on record as lack of new AI deals, US daily users metric disappoints
excerpt: Reddit shares plunged the most on record on Friday after US daily users, lack of new AI deal announcements dissapointed investors.
content_html:
What happened: Reddit (RDDT) stock plunged nearly 21% on Friday, its largest intraday decline since the company went public.

What's behind the move: The user discussion platform company's latest earnings report did not announce any new artificial intelligence data licensing agreements, disappointing investors who were expecting more revenue opportunities from AI partnerships.

Revenue of $804.9 million beat estimates of $731.8 million. However, US daily active users came in at 53.2 million, just shy of expectations of 54 million. The company's total daily active users grew by 18% to 130.3 million versus estimates of 130.07 million.

What else you need to know: Reddit's main revenue comes from its advertising business, but Wall Street has increasingly focused on the potential of Reddit's data licensing deals, given the platform's massive collection of user-generated discussions, which have become valuable for AI companies training models.

The company has already signed major agreements with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) and Google (GOOG, GOOGL).

When asked about new deals by an analyst, CEO Steve Huffman said, "These deals aren't binary. They have to make sense for Reddit, but there are many ways, I think, for the value to return to Reddit."

At the same time, Huffman noted "headwinds" in search referrals as AI changes how users discover online content.

"Search referrals were choppy in the quarter, and traffic was more volatile later in the quarter," he said, later adding: "Our visibility on search continues to remain low, and we expect it to probably continue to be volatile."

Ines Ferre is a senior business reporter for Yahoo Finance. Follow her on X at @ines_ferre.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么：Reddit (RDDT) 股价周五暴跌近 21%，这是该公司上市以来的最大盘中跌幅。

此举背后的原因：这家用户讨论平台公司最新的财报并未宣布任何新的人工智能数据许可协议，这让原本期待从人工智能合作伙伴关系中获得更多收入机会的投资者感到失望。

收入为 8.049 亿美元，超出预期的 7.318 亿美元。 然而，美国每日活跃用户数为 5320 万，略低于预期的 5400 万。 该公司的每日活跃用户总数增长了 18%，达到 1.303 亿，而预期为 1.3007 亿。

您还需要了解什么：Reddit 的主要收入来自其广告业务，但考虑到该平台收集了大量用户生成的讨论，华尔街越来越关注 Reddit 数据许可交易的潜力，这些讨论对于人工智能公司的训练模型变得很有价值。

该公司已经与 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 和谷歌 (GOOG、GOOGL) 签署了重要协议。

当分析师询问新交易时，首席执行官史蒂夫霍夫曼表示：“这些交易不是二元的。 它们必须对 Reddit 有意义，但我认为，有很多方法可以让其价值回归 Reddit。”

与此同时，霍夫曼指出，随着人工智能改变用户发现在线内容的方式，搜索推荐中出现了“逆风”。

他表示：“本季度的搜索推荐量波动很大，本季度晚些时候的流量波动更大。”他后来补充道：“我们在搜索上的可见度仍然很低，我们预计它可能会继续波动。”
